from __future__ import annotations

import contextlib
import io
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))

from native_config import native_environment  # noqa: E402


class NativeConfigTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def write_environment(self, content: str) -> Path:
        temporary_directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(temporary_directory.cleanup)
        environment_file = Path(temporary_directory.name) / "infra.env"
        environment_file.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        return environment_file

    def complete_environment(self) -> str:
        return "\n".join(
            [
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_PORT=18093",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_POSTGRES_HOST=127.0.0.1",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_POSTGRES_PORT=5432",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_DATABASE=lw_planner",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_NATS_URL=nats://127.0.0.1:4222",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_STUDENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18084",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_COURSE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18083",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_AI_PROMPT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18092",
                "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_TZ_PLANNER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18088",
                "LW_PLANNER_DB_USER=lw_planner",
                "LW_PLANNER_DB_PASSWORD=planner-private-password",
                "LW_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=shared-fallback-password",
                "LW_INTERNAL_TOKEN=general-private-token",
                "LW_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN=teacher-private-token",
                "LW_PLANNER_PRACTICE_TOKEN=practice-private-token",
                "LW_STUDENT_PLANNER_TOKEN=student-write-private-token",
                "LW_COURSE_PLANNER_TOKEN=course-write-private-token",
                "LW_COURSE_DIAGNOSTIC_TOKEN=course-diagnostic-private-token",
                "LW_PLANNER_TZ_TOKEN=tz-private-token",
                "LW_PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_TOKEN=handoff-private-token",
            ]
        ) + "\n"

    def test_native_environment_uses_registered_endpoints_and_existing_secrets(self) -> None:
        environment_file = self.write_environment(self.complete_environment())
        output = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
            environment = native_environment(environment_file, {})

        self.assertEqual(environment["HTTP_ADDR"], "127.0.0.1:18093")
        self.assertEqual(environment["NATS_URL"], "nats://127.0.0.1:4222")
        self.assertEqual(environment["STUDENT_SERVICE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18084")
        self.assertEqual(environment["COURSE_SERVICE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18083")
        self.assertEqual(environment["AI_PROMPT_SERVICE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18092")
        self.assertEqual(environment["TZ_PLANNER_SERVICE_URL"], "http://127.0.0.1:18088")
        self.assertEqual(environment["INTERNAL_API_TOKEN"], "general-private-token")
        self.assertEqual(environment["TEACHER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN"], "teacher-private-token")
        self.assertEqual(environment["TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN"], "handoff-private-token")
        for source_secret in (
            "LW_PLANNER_DB_PASSWORD",
            "LW_POSTGRES_PASSWORD",
            "LW_INTERNAL_TOKEN",
            "LW_PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_TOKEN",
        ):
            self.assertNotIn(source_secret, environment)

        database = urlsplit(environment["DATABASE_URL"])
        self.assertEqual(database.scheme, "postgres")
        self.assertEqual(database.hostname, "127.0.0.1")
        self.assertEqual(database.port, 5432)
        self.assertEqual(unquote(database.username or ""), "lw_planner")
        self.assertEqual(unquote(database.password or ""), "planner-private-password")
        self.assertEqual(database.path, "/lw_planner")
        for secret in ("planner-private-password", "general-private-token", "handoff-private-token"):
            self.assertNotIn(secret, output.getvalue())

    def test_native_environment_uses_shared_password_only_as_fallback(self) -> None:
        content = self.complete_environment().replace("LW_PLANNER_DB_PASSWORD=planner-private-password\n", "")
        environment_file = self.write_environment(content)
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            environment = native_environment(environment_file, {})

        self.assertEqual(unquote(urlsplit(environment["DATABASE_URL"]).password or ""), "shared-fallback-password")

    def test_missing_registry_mapping_fails_closed(self) -> None:
        content = self.complete_environment().replace(
            "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_STUDENT_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18084\n", ""
        )
        environment_file = self.write_environment(content)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_STUDENT_URL is required"):
            native_environment(environment_file, {})

    def test_docker_or_non_loopback_dependency_endpoint_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        content = self.complete_environment().replace(
            "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_COURSE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18083\n",
            "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_COURSE_URL=http://course:8080\n",
        )
        environment_file = self.write_environment(content)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_COURSE_URL must be a registered loopback URL"):
            native_environment(environment_file, {})

    def test_invalid_listener_and_port_values_are_rejected(self) -> None:
        content = self.complete_environment().replace(
            "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST=127.0.0.1\n",
            "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST=0.0.0.0\n",
        )
        environment_file = self.write_environment(content)

        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "LEARNING_PLANNER_NATIVE_HTTP_HOST must use the registered loopback host"):
            native_environment(environment_file, {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
